enter.title: Opening your page
enter.expired: This link has expired or was already used.
enter.needNew: Enter your email and we will send you a new link.
enter.sent: If that email has access, a new link is on its way. It works for 15 minutes.

list.empty: Nothing has been shared with you yet.

share.error: Could not load this page. It may have been withdrawn.

jd.title: Job description
jd.intro: Please review the role as we understand it. Approve it, or tell us what to change.
jd.missing: Not in the description. Please let us know.

decision.approved: Thank you. Your approval is recorded.
decision.changesSent: Thank you. Your comments were sent.
decision.stale: This was updated while you were reading. Reload to see the newest version.

hmDecision.title: Your decision
hmDecision.hint: This goes to the recruiter, who confirms the next step with you.
hmDecision.sent: Sent. The recruiter will confirm the next step.
hmDecision.pending: A decision is waiting for the recruiter.

feedback.title: Interview feedback
feedback.hint: Rate the most recent interview round.
feedback.sent: Thank you. Your feedback was sent.
feedback.noRound: There is no interview round to give feedback on yet.

resume.title: Your resume for {position}
resume.intro: This is the version we plan to send to {client}. Please check every line is true, then approve it or ask for changes.

consent.title: Consent
consent.intro: We only send your details to a company with your permission. You can give or withdraw it at any time.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.intro: You can ask for a copy of your data or for it to be deleted. We answer within {days} days.
privacy.export: Send me a copy of my data
privacy.sent: Your request was sent. We will answer within {days} days.
privacy.open: You already have an open request of this kind.
privacy.deleteWarn: Deleting removes your profile, resumes and documents. It cannot be undone.

intake.title: Questions about {position}
intake.intro: Answer what you can, in your own words. Your answers go to the recruiter, who reads them before using them. You can send more later.
intake.sent: Thank you. Your answers were sent to the recruiter.

slots.title: Offer interview times
slots.hint: Offer up to five times. The recruiter confirms one and sets up the interview. Nothing is booked until then.
slots.format: Format (optional), for example video or onsite
slots.sent: Thank you. The recruiter will confirm one of them.
slots.pending: Times are already waiting for the recruiter.
slots.past: Offer times that are still ahead.
slots.cannot: Times cannot be offered for this candidate right now.

details.title: My details
details.intro: Tell us what changed. Your recruiter checks it and then updates your profile; nothing changes until they do. Fill in only what changed.
details.sent: Sent. Your recruiter will review it.
details.none: You have not sent anything yet.
